description: Fetch recent posts from a LinkedIn person profile. 5 credits per page of 50, up to 250 posts, charged only for pages actually fetched. Results are stored in the post library (source_type='external') and linked to a linkedin_profiles row so profile-brief can render research-only prospects.

max_posts.description: Maximum posts to return (1-250). 5 credits per page of 50, charged only for pages actually fetched.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and re-fetch from LinkedIn (5 credits per page of 50, charged only for pages actually fetched). Default false: a previously-fetched result is returned free, with how long ago it was retrieved.

name: linkedin_profile_posts
title: LinkedIn Profile Posts
